concepts.title: Neon Safehouse
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production concept art for the 2.5D pixel-art cyberpunk hacking roguelike Risk_v2. Create one richly composed landscape 3:2 artwork, ideally 1536x1024. Art-only environment, no UI, absolutely no typography, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Deliberately hand-placed-looking crisp pixel clusters, sophisticated limited palette, layered depth, tiny convincing material details, selective emissive highlights and restrained cinematic atmospheric lighting; premium HD-2D game art, NOT a photograph, NOT smooth vector, NOT glossy generic 3D, NOT an oil painting, NOT indiscriminate neon noise. A tightly framed readable diorama with a clear center of interest; the central horizontal band must remain compelling and legible when used as a very short 420x150 scene crop in a compact portrait game. Strong foreground/midground/background separation. Mostly dark values with carefully rationed bright focus. Large distinctive silhouettes survive reduction; detail rewards enlargement. No humanoid characters or implied exploration controls. Scene: an intimate three-quarter isometric hacker workstation in a cramped rooftop safehouse at night, desk and three asymmetric CRT monitors centered; luminous abstract circuit patterns only on screens, no writing. Heavy cables curl from the desk to a small server tower. The wide rain-streaked window behind looks into a layered cyberpunk city of shadowed buildings and a few electric signs with only abstract geometric marks. A foreground sill and deep shadow frame the room. Distinctive palette: midnight aubergine, rich violet shadows, cool turquoise CRT glow, a few muted fuchsia city accents, warm ivory monitor highlights. Rain and soft distant atmospheric haze outside, tactile worn plastics and metal indoors. The CRT cluster and desk dominate the central band, the city gives convincing depth. Evoke solitary late-night hacking and quiet suspense. Compose a complete beautiful shot without UI space or blank banners.
